name: 1D-LSD
summary: 1D-LSD, also known as 1-(1,2-dimethylcyclobutane-1-carbonyl)-LSD or as SYN-L-229, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is believed to be a prodrug of LSD and replaced 1V-LSD in Germany after 1V-LSD became covered by the German NpSG law in 2022.

pharmacology.text: It is believed to be a prodrug of LSD and replaced 1V-LSD in Germany after 1V-LSD became covered by the German NpSG law in 2022.

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer drug, mainly in Germany, as a stand in for LSD.
uses.zh: 它作為LSD的替代品以設計師藥物的形式販售，主要在德國。
uses.zhHans: 它作为LSD的替代品以设计师药物的形式贩售，主要在德国。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: It appeared after Germany's NpSG law of 2022 began to cover 1V-LSD. That law bans whole chemical groups rather than single drugs, so sellers moved to bulkier groups such as this dimethylcyclobutane one.
fact.zh: 它是在德國的NpSG法於2022年開始涵蓋1V-LSD後出現的。該法禁止的是整個化學類別而非單一藥物，因此販售者改用像這個二甲基環丁烷這樣更大的取代基。
fact.zhHans: 它是在德国的NpSG法于2022年开始涵盖1V-LSD后出现的。该法禁止的是整个化学类别而非单一药物，因此贩售者改用像这个二甲基环丁烷这样更大的取代基。
